protocol_name: LOCO Few-shot Adapted vs Cold-start Zero-shot Paired Statistics
frozen_after: A40/A50/A60 H24 and A70/A80/A90 H48 all PASS/CLOSED; before adapted-vs-zero inferential analysis
scientific_question: Does few-shot head adaptation using recent target-city labeled PV history improve a previously unseen city's cold-start zero-shot forecast on the unchanged 2024-2025 independent Test grid?
comparison: Each adapted budget is paired against the same frozen cold-start zero-shot model for the same held-out city, seed, forecast origin, and horizon step.
deep_model_loss_handling: Compute squared and absolute loss separately for each seed at each paired residual, then average loss across seeds. Do not average predictions into an ensemble.

metrics.RMSE: paired squared loss; point estimate is sqrt(mean seed-averaged squared loss)
metrics.MAE: paired absolute loss; point estimate is mean seed-averaged absolute loss

effect_sign: adapted minus cold-start zero-shot; negative favors adaptation

bootstrap.type: paired circular moving-block bootstrap over UTC forecast-origin day

multiplicity.pooled_family: 3 budgets within each horizon x daytype x metric
multiplicity.city_family: 15 cities x 3 budgets within each horizon x daytype x metric

strong_support_rule: Paired 95% bootstrap CI excludes zero AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
cross_budget_policy: No inferential test of 30d versus 90d versus 365d is run. Budget curves are descriptive because budget size and seasonal coverage are linked by the frozen recent-history design.
